prompts.trees: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is the established Solace miniature-rendered STYLE and material/palette reference, not a layout target. Generate ONE coherent transparent variant atlas, rendered handcrafted miniatures, cool mossy highland greens with warm ochre timber, consistent soft upper-left light and same overhead orthographic three-quarter camera as reference. Genuine transparent background. No grid lines, labels, text, frame, scenic backdrop, circular soil islands, pedestals or terrain plates. Each subject isolated with only a SMALL soft contact shadow. All subjects full and uncropped. Leave at least 12% empty gutters between every cell and 8% margin at sheet perimeter. Equal cell sizes, centers aligned, common baseline. Subject fits completely within its own cell. Variations subtle and compatible, preserve subject recognition and game footprint, no wildly different architecture or biome. Large readable shape masses, avoid tiny noisy detail. 2 columns x 2 rows. FOUR broadleaf woodland tree variants: rounded broad crown; slightly taller oval crown; asymmetrical branching crown; compact stout crown. Same species family, blue-teal clustered foliage and brown trunk, varied clump placement and natural branching. Canopies occupy similar width, trunks visible. No flowers, no pine trees, no scattered plants around feet. These repeat densely on adjacent square game tiles.
